name: SEC filings for Wix and Shopify
measures: Annual revenue of Wix and Shopify
about: Public companies report revenue to the US Securities and Exchange Commission, which publishes it through a free API. We add up these two companies' annual revenue.
attribution: Revenue from filings on SEC EDGAR.
limitations: It covers two companies, and private no-code businesses publish no comparable numbers.
Revenue reflects pricing, payments and shopping as well as how many people build without code.
